subject: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for OpsPlay pilot
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@opsplay.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing / PO exception request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the pilot. Quick ask from our side: OpsPlay runs a monthly invoicing cadence and our legal asks invoices rather than purchase orders for small pilots. For this initial 3-month pilot (estimated spend ~ $12K total) we were hoping to onboard without a PO so we can start immediately and have you invoice monthly.

We can provide:
- Signed SOW (attached)
- W-9 and company registration (can send immediately)
- A short risk summary (attached) that explains data handling and separation of logs

Would Redwood consider a temporary no-PO path for the pilot, with a commitment to move to standard PO terms if we convert? If helpful, we can limit the pilot to a single invoice per month and pre-agree a cap.

Attachments: OpsPlay_SOW.pdf (pdf), OpsPlay_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (xlsx), OpsPlay_Risk_Summary.docx (docx)

Appreciate your guidance — Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Partnerships, OpsPlay
samir@opsplay.io

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot billing / PO exception request

Forwarding OpsPlay's ask — pilot estimate ~$12K, monthly invoice cadence, they provided SOW and risk summary.

Context / recommendation: OpsPlay is a product partner that integrates with our console; Sales (Marissa) is pushing for fast start to validate a feature. I'm OK with a temporary invoice-only path for the trial under these constraints:
- Max exposure $15K during pilot
- One invoice per month, Net30
- Procurement to capture evidence (W-9, signed SOW, risk summary) and set a time-bound exception in the system

Priya — can Procurement create a conditional exception (30-day duration with mandatory handoff to PO on conversion) and confirm any legal or SOC evidence gaps? Karthik, tagging you for legal sign-off on the SOW language around billing.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot billing / PO exception request

Thanks — reviewed OpsPlay packet. A few items we need before Procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding:

Required evidence (please ask OpsPlay to upload these to the vendor portal):
- Completed onboarding form (we have their xlsx but prefer via portal)
- W-9 (tax form)
- Proof of primary contact and invoicing email
- Short security attestation (SOC2 or the attached risk summary)

Conditional terms I'm willing to authorize (procurement):
- One-time, 90-day exception limited to pilot spend cap of $15,000
- Monthly invoicing, Net30 (we will not pay until invoice approved by assigned PM)
- Exception expires automatically at 90 days; if they convert, a standard PO must be in place prior to work continuing beyond cap or term
- Procurement will log an "exception" record in the system and attach the SOW + risk summary

Two procurement points: 1) If OpsPlay handles any PII or access to customer data, we need a short SOC2/attestation — their risk summary is helpful but may require follow-up. 2) Finance needs a billing code and assigned approver (Sales should confirm).

Next steps: Soojin/Marissa, can you confirm the assigned approver for invoices and ask OpsPlay to upload W-9 + portal form? Once received we'll create the exception and share the one-time vendor ID.

Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot billing / PO exception request — APPROVED (conditional)

Thanks team — I approve the conditional exception as outlined by Priya. Key points from Sales perspective:
- Pilot is time-boxed; moving fast matters for momentum.
- Approver for invoices will be me (Marissa Cole) during the pilot; finance billing code: SAL-OPS-2027
- Sales will escalate if conversion is likely before 90 days so Procurement/Legal can fast-track a PO

Priya: please create the vendor exception record and issue a temporary vendor ID. Karthik: if you see any legal red flags in the SOW, flag immediately but otherwise proceed. Soojin: tell OpsPlay to upload W-9 and confirm that billing email is billing@opsplay.io.

I'll also add a quick note to the HubSpot deal so Finance and CS see the arrangement: https://hubspot.com/deal/OPSPLAY-4871

Appreciate the quick turn — Marissa

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
